info.name: MediQueue Patroni E2E Auto 20P 5D 60 Citas Pagos Notificaciones
info.description:
Coleccion automatica para ejecutar contra el API Gateway de MediQueue levantado con Patroni:
`start-patroni-e2e-backend.ps1 -Build -ForceRecreate`.

Flujo automatico:
- POST 20 pacientes.
- POST 5 odontologos.
- POST 60 slots.
- POST 60 citas.
- Los 60 pagos aprobados se generan por el flujo E2E real: appointment.held -> payment-service -> payment.succeeded.
- Las 60 notificaciones se generan por los eventos payment.succeeded publicados por payment-service.

Importante: esta coleccion no crea notificaciones manualmente. Tampoco fuerza pagos manuales para evitar conflictos con el flujo asincrono automatico de Patroni E2E.

exec: if (pm.response.code !== 200) { console.error('Backend no saludable. Deteniendo coleccion.'); postman.setNextRequest(null); return; }
console.log('MediQueue Patroni E2E Auto runStamp=' + stamp);
if (![200,201].includes(pm.response.code)) { console.error('Fallo creando paciente', pm.response.code, body); postman.setNextRequest(null); return; }
const json = pm.response.json(); const id = json.patientId || json.id;
if (!id) { throw new Error('La respuesta no trae patientId'); }
postman.setNextRequest(i < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('totalPatients')) ? '01 - Create Patient Loop' : '02 - Create Dentist Loop');
const i = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('dentistIndex') || 0); const n = i + 1; const padded = String(n).padStart(3, '0');
const body = pm.response.text(); pm.test('Odontologo creado 201/200', function () { pm.expect([200,201]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (![200,201].includes(pm.response.code)) { console.error('Fallo creando odontologo', pm.response.code, body); postman.setNextRequest(null); return; }
const json = pm.response.json(); const id = json.dentistId || json.id; if (!id) { throw new Error('La respuesta no trae dentistId'); }
postman.setNextRequest(i < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('totalDentists')) ? '02 - Create Dentist Loop' : '03 - Create Slot Loop');
if (dentists.length === 0) { throw new Error('No hay odontologos para crear slots'); }
const date = new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 8, 1 + dayOffset)); const slotDate = date.toISOString().slice(0,10);
const startMinutes = 8 * 60 + slotInDay * 30; const endMinutes = startMinutes + 30;
const body = pm.response.text(); pm.test('Slot creado 201/200', function () { pm.expect([200,201]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (![200,201].includes(pm.response.code)) { console.error('Fallo creando slot', pm.response.code, body); postman.setNextRequest(null); return; }
const json = pm.response.json(); const id = json.slotId || json.id; if (!id) { throw new Error('La respuesta no trae slotId'); }

const payloads = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('slotPayloads') || '[]'); payloads.push({ slotId: id, dentistId: pm.collectionVariables.get('currentDentistId'), slotDate: pm.collectionVariables.get('currentSlotDate'), startTime: pm.collectionVariables.get('currentStartTime'), endTime: pm.collectionVariables.get('currentEndTime') }); pm.collectionVariables.set('slotPayloads', JSON.stringify(payloads));
postman.setNextRequest(i < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('totalSlots')) ? '03 - Create Slot Loop' : '04 - Create Appointment Loop');

const i = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('appointmentIndex') || 0); const patients = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('patientIds') || '[]'); const slots = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('slotPayloads') || '[]');
if (patients.length === 0 || !slots[i]) { throw new Error('Faltan pacientes o slots para cita index ' + i); }
const slot = slots[i]; const patientId = patients[i % patients.length];

pm.collectionVariables.set('currentPatientId', patientId); pm.collectionVariables.set('currentDentistId', slot.dentistId); pm.collectionVariables.set('currentSlotId', slot.slotId); pm.collectionVariables.set('currentSlotDate', slot.slotDate); pm.collectionVariables.set('currentStartTime', slot.startTime); pm.collectionVariables.set('currentEndTime', slot.endTime); pm.collectionVariables.set('appointmentNumber', String(i + 1));
const body = pm.response.text(); pm.test('Cita creada 201/200/202', function () { pm.expect([200,201,202]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (![200,201,202].includes(pm.response.code)) { console.error('Fallo creando cita', pm.response.code, body); postman.setNextRequest(null); return; }
const json = pm.response.json(); const id = json.appointmentId || json.id; if (!id) { throw new Error('La respuesta no trae appointmentId'); }
postman.setNextRequest(i < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('totalAppointments')) ? '04 - Create Appointment Loop' : '05 - Wait Until 60 Approved Payments');

if (page === 0) { const waitMs = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('asyncWaitMs') || 3000); const until = Date.now() + waitMs; while (Date.now() < until) {} console.log('Esperando pagos aprobados ' + waitMs + ' ms'); }
const json = pm.response.json(); const content = json.content || []; const appointmentIds = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('appointmentIds') || '[]');
content.filter(p => appointmentIds.includes(p.appointmentId) && p.paymentStatus === 'APPROVED').forEach(p => { if (p.paymentId || p.id) existing.add(p.paymentId || p.id); });

const expected = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('expectedApprovedPayments') || 60); const page = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentPageIndex') || 0); const totalPages = Number(json.totalPages || 1); const maxPages = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('maxAsyncPages') || 10);
console.log(`Pagos aprobados de esta corrida=${ids.length}/${expected}, page=${page + 1}/${totalPages}`);

if (ids.length < expected && page + 1 < totalPages && page + 1 < maxPages) { pm.collectionVariables.set('paymentPageIndex', String(page + 1)); postman.setNextRequest('05 - Wait Until 60 Approved Payments'); return; }

if (ids.length < expected && cycles < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('maxAsyncCycles') || 30)) { pm.collectionVariables.set('paymentPageIndex', '0'); pm.collectionVariables.set('approvedPaymentScanIds', '[]'); postman.setNextRequest('05 - Wait Until 60 Approved Payments'); return; }
pm.test('Hay 60 pagos APPROVED para las citas creadas', function () { pm.expect(ids.length).to.be.at.least(expected); });

if (page === 0) { const waitMs = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('asyncWaitMs') || 3000); const until = Date.now() + waitMs; while (Date.now() < until) {} console.log('Esperando notificaciones de pagos ' + waitMs + ' ms'); }
const json = pm.response.json(); const content = json.content || []; const appointmentIds = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('appointmentIds') || '[]');

content.filter(n => appointmentIds.includes(n.appointmentId) && (n.routingKey === 'payment.succeeded' || n.sourceEventType === 'PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED' || n.eventType === 'PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED')).forEach(n => { if (n.notificationId || n.id) existing.add(n.notificationId || n.id); });

const expected = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('expectedPaymentNotifications') || 60); const page = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('notificationPageIndex') || 0); const totalPages = Number(json.totalPages || 1); const maxPages = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('maxAsyncPages') || 10);
console.log(`Notificaciones payment.succeeded de esta corrida=${ids.length}/${expected}, page=${page + 1}/${totalPages}`);

if (ids.length < expected && page + 1 < totalPages && page + 1 < maxPages) { pm.collectionVariables.set('notificationPageIndex', String(page + 1)); postman.setNextRequest('06 - Wait Until 60 Payment Notifications'); return; }

if (ids.length < expected && cycles < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('maxAsyncCycles') || 30)) { pm.collectionVariables.set('notificationPageIndex', '0'); pm.collectionVariables.set('paymentNotificationScanIds', '[]'); postman.setNextRequest('06 - Wait Until 60 Payment Notifications'); return; }
pm.test('Hay 60 notificaciones de pagos aprobados para las citas creadas', function () { pm.expect(ids.length).to.be.at.least(expected); });

const i = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('getPatientIndex') || 0); const ids = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('patientIds') || '[]'); if (!ids[i]) throw new Error('No patient id for GET index ' + i); pm.collectionVariables.set('currentPatientId', ids[i]);
postman.setNextRequest(i < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('totalPatients')) ? '09 - GET Created Patient Loop' : '10 - GET Created Dentist Loop');

const i = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('getDentistIndex') || 0); const ids = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('dentistIds') || '[]'); if (!ids[i]) throw new Error('No dentist id for GET index ' + i); pm.collectionVariables.set('currentDentistId', ids[i]);
postman.setNextRequest(i < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('totalDentists')) ? '10 - GET Created Dentist Loop' : '11 - GET Slots By First Dentist');

const i = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('getAppointmentIndex') || 0); const ids = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('appointmentIds') || '[]'); if (!ids[i]) throw new Error('No appointment id for GET index ' + i); pm.collectionVariables.set('currentAppointmentId', ids[i]);
postman.setNextRequest(i < Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('totalAppointments')) ? '13 - GET Created Appointment Loop' : '14 - GET Appointments By First Patient');
const j = pm.response.json(); console.log('Pagos aprobados totalElements=' + j.totalElements + ', content=' + (j.content || []).length);
const j = pm.response.json(); console.log('Notificaciones SENT totalElements=' + j.totalElements + ', content=' + (j.content || []).length);
postman.setNextRequest('18 - GET Notifications By First Patient');

const summary = { patients: JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('patientIds') || '[]').length, dentists: JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('dentistIds') || '[]').length, slots: JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('slotIds') || '[]').length, appointments: JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('appointmentIds') || '[]').length, approvedPayments: JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('approvedPaymentIds') || '[]').length, paymentNotifications: JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentNotificationIds') || '[]').length, runStamp: pm.collectionVariables.get('runStamp') };

request.description: Opcional. Usar manualmente solo si desactivas el flujo asincrono de pagos, porque en Patroni E2E cada cita ya genera un pago aprobado por evento appointment.held.
